fields.subject: ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable
fields.response: return false when the failure is the procedure's concurrency signal (a SqlException with error number 51000, raised when the TableVersion etag does not match or a row for the silo already exists); otherwise log the exception and propagate it to the caller
fields.postcondition: InsertRow returns true when the insert query completes without throwing, false for an etag/version conflict or an already-existing silo row, and never converts a connection, timeout, or other non-conflict failure into a false result
